# simttepower

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

simttepower is a companion to [simtte](https://github.com/csetraynor/simtte),
providing trial replication and simulation-based power and
operating-characteristic analysis on top of simtte's single-cohort PK/PD
time-to-event simulator. Given a trial design and a grid of scenarios that
vary any one factor (a model parameter, a formula coefficient, a dosing
regimen, a sampling schedule, sample size, follow-up, or covariate
distribution), simttepower replicates each scenario, applies one or more
analysis functions to each simulated trial, and summarises operating
characteristics -- power, type I error, bias, coverage -- across the grid.

## Installation

You can install the development version of simttepower from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("csetraynor/simttepower")
```

## Example

Two arms of a built-in PK/PD hazard model, varying the nonlinear-link
`IC50` parameter on the experimental arm, replicated and summarised:

```{r example}
library(simttepower)

comparator <- arm(label = "comparator", n = 40, model = "irm1_hazard",
  end = 24, param = list(CL = 2, V2 = 20, KA = 1, KIN = 1, KOUT = 0.5,
    IC50 = 1, IMAX = 0.9, H0 = 0.15))
experimental <- arm(label = "experimental", n = 40, model = "irm1_hazard",
  end = 24, param = list(CL = 2, V2 = 20, KA = 1, KIN = 1, KOUT = 0.5,
    IC50 = 1, IMAX = 0.9, H0 = 0.15))

design <- trial_design(
  arms = list(comparator, experimental),
  analyses = list(coxph = analysis_coxph)
)

grid <- scenario_grid(design, over = list(arm = "experimental",
  field = "param.IC50", values = c(1, 2, 4)))

res <- power_sim(grid, n_sims = 5, seed = 1, progress = FALSE)
summary(res)
```

See `vignette("power-analysis")` for a real dosing-regimen contrast, a
covariate-adjusted analysis, and a direction-aware rejection rule.
